teams.title: Team Management
teams.avatarHint: Recommended: 200x200 pixels. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, ICO. Maximum size: 10 MB
teams.removeMemberConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove "{name}" from the team?
teams.leaveTeamConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave team "{name}"? You will no longer have access to this team's resources.
teams.transferOwnershipConfirm: Are you sure you want to transfer ownership to "{name}"? You will lose owner privileges.
teams.createTeamHint: Click the button above to create your first team
teams.deleteTeamConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete team "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
teams.confirmBulkDelete: Are you sure you want to delete {count} selected teams? This action cannot be undone.
teams.addModelHint: Click the button above to authorize models
teams.priorityHint: Higher value means higher priority. Models of the same type are sorted by priority.
teams.revokeModelAuthConfirm: Are you sure you want to revoke authorization for "{name}"? The team will no longer be able to use this model.
teams.basicSettingsDesc: View and update team profile information
teams.modelAuthDescription: Manage authorized models and quota limits for the team
teams.dangerZoneDesc: High-risk actions including leaving the team
teams.leaveTeamDesc: You will lose access to all resources in this team upon leaving
teams.ownerCannotLeaveWarning: As the team owner, you cannot directly leave the team. Please transfer ownership first.
teams.addMemberPrompt: Select a user from the system to join the team
teams.addMemberExactHint: Enter the exact username or email address of the user to add them directly
teams.userIdentifierPlaceholder: Enter exact username or email, e.g. john or john@example.com

toolApprovals.title: Tool approval policies
toolApprovals.description: Each tool keeps its own approval policy. Choose whether its calls run immediately, are always denied, or wait for the caller to confirm. This page changes only tool-level policies; it never creates team, site, entrypoint, or workflow approval steps.
toolApprovals.loadFailed: Could not load the tools available to this team.
toolApprovals.readDenied: You do not have permission to view this team's tools.
toolApprovals.empty: No tools available to this team
toolApprovals.emptyHint: Built-in tools and tools created or shared with this team will appear here.
toolApprovals.legacyBlocked: This policy still names approvers that are no longer supported. Reset them in the editor before saving.
toolApprovals.editDescription: Only this tool's own approval policy changes. Choose a default decision and, for MCP tools, optional per-operation overrides using the exact operation name (for example tool:search).
toolApprovals.saveFailed: Could not update the approval policy.

readOnly.sharedTool: Managed by the team that shared this tool.
readOnly.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to update tools.
readOnly.privateTool: Only the creator can change this private tool.
readOnly.teamAdminOnly: Only the creator or a team admin can change this tool.
readOnly.policyUnavailable: This tool's team definition could not be loaded, so its approval policy is unavailable. Reload the list before editing it.
